title.narrative: Oxfam Market access for women and food security
Oxfam Market access for women and food security

description.narrative: Insatsen inkluderar tre komponenter: 1) tillgång till marknader; 2) ökad produktion och strategiska spannmålsreserver; 3) förhindra könsbaserat våld;

The programme consists of three parts: 1) providing access to markets; 2) increasing production and creating strategic reserves of grains; 3) preventing and providing help to women victim of gender-based violence;

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Main final results related to the inteded outcome: -77% farmer organisations (20 women`s farmer organisation) have increased by 85% their marketability through identified channels of merchandising such as the business enterprises: SIESA, Grupo CEIS and Cooperativa Cuatro Pinos. -Farmers organisations have increased their incomes by 85% as a result of the traiding of their products. -100% of the most vulnerable families have access to food during the "lean period". 45% are women heads of household. -31% of the board members of mixed organisations are women and are more involved in decision making.
